signal: Minitab jumped to #17 in G2's 2026 Best Data Analytics Software ranking (from #47 in 2025) and shipped enhanced AI capabilities in its platform.

email.body1:
David, saw Minitab jumped to #17 in G2's 2026 data analytics ranking, up from #47, on the back of new AI capabilities.

A jump like that usually surfaces more in-market accounts across the US and EMEA than the team can cover, and that is where pipeline goes cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Minitab off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
David, quick follow-up for Minitab.

Covering both US and EMEA, the list of accounts worth working tends to outrun a BD team faster than expected. Most orgs don't know exactly how many meetings they need to hit target, so the gap shows up late in the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show how many meetings your regions need to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
David, last bit of proof for Minitab.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks.

I pulled a benchmark of how Minitab's reply rate likely compares to peer analytics firms. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
David, I will stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Running BD across two regions is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your US and EMEA motion? I will tailor it to Minitab either way.
